subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC trial plan - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Maria Jenkins <maria.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC trial plan - Acme Industries

Hi Maria - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed PoC/trial plan so we can align on next steps.

Key items from the call:
- Primary workload: document understanding + summarization for customer support (real-time routing + batch indexing).
- Expected peak throughput: ~150 QPS during peak windows, steady-state ~20 QPS.
- Latency target: p95 generation latency <= 250ms for short prompts (~256 tokens).
- Data sensitivity: some PII in support transcripts - need to discuss data residency, KMS integration, and audit logs.
- Existing infra: AWS (us-west-2), internal CI/CD and SRE team to own deployment access.

Deployment mode considerations you mentioned:
- Hosted API: fastest to test but may be challenging for throughput/cost at scale.
- Dedicated capacity: preferred for predictable throughput and isolation - looks like the strong contender.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): likely required if compliance requires customer-managed network and keys.

Proposed PoC / trial plan (attached: PoC_trial_plan_v1.pdf):
- Goal: validate performance, cost, and integration surface for production rollout.
- Duration: 4 weeks (can be shortened to 3 weeks for an accelerated path).
- Tracks: Dedicated trial (default) + optional Private VPC validation if compliance gate present.
- Success criteria (examples):
  * Performance: p95 latency <= 250ms for 256-token generation under 150 QPS peak with <= 5% error rate.
  * Throughput: sustained 120 QPS for 30-min window without throttling.
  * Reliability: >= 99.5% successful request rate under load.
  * Security/compliance: KMS integration for encryption at rest, audit log access, and SOC2 artifacts review.
  * Integration: seamless token-based auth and sample client integration into your CI/CD.
- Timeline (suggested):
  Week 0: Kickoff, account setup, access and network checks (Redwood + Acme SRE).
  Week 1: Baseline Hosted/Dedicated setup; sample integration and smoke tests.
  Week 2: Load testing and latency tuning; run representative workloads.
  Week 3: Private VPC validation (if needed) + security reviews.
  Week 4: Final evaluation, cost estimates, and next-step recommendations.

What I need from you to finalize the plan:
1) Confirm which track(s) you want to run (Dedicated only, Dedicated + Private, or start Hosted then escalate).
2) Success criteria you care most about (pick top 3 from the list or add your own).
3) Stakeholder list for the PoC (who owns SRE, security/compliance, and product sign-off).
4) Preferred kickoff week (we have capacity starting week of Mar 14).

Next steps: If it works for you, I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call with Marissa (solutions engineering) and Jordan (pre-sales) to lock scope and access. I've attached the draft PoC plan; happy to update based on your feedback.

Thanks - talk soon.

-
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: PoC_trial_plan_v1.pdf (4 pages)
From: Maria Jenkins <maria.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC trial plan - Acme Industries

Hi Ben - appreciate the clear recap and the plan. A few quick answers from our side: 

1) Tracks: We'd like to run the Dedicated track first to validate performance and cost. If Dedicated meets our security gating, we'll proceed to Private VPC for the PII workloads.

2) Top success criteria (our priorities):
- Security/compliance: KMS integration and evidence for encryption at rest (this is non-negotiable for PII).
- Performance: p95 latency under 300ms at 150 QPS for our top-10 prompt families.
- Integration effort: ability to deploy a client and integrate with our CI in <= 2 weeks.

3) Stakeholders:
- Carlos Mendoza, Head of ML (carlos.mendoza@acme.com) - owns model infra + scale tests.
- Linda Park, Director SRE (linda.park@acme.com) - will own network and access for Dedicated / VPC.
- Raj Patel, Security (raj.patel@acme.com) - will run SOC2 and KMS checks.

4) Timeline: Mar 14 kickoff works well for us. We do have an internal compliance review window the week of Mar 28; if possible we'd like the Private VPC validation to be completed prior to that so we can feed results into the review.

Questions for you: 
- For Dedicated, do you support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or is that only for Private VPC?
- What is required from our SRE for the Dedicated setup (eg. IP allowlist, SSH, VPN)?

Thanks - I can jump on a 30-min call next week to finalize.

Best,
Maria
Director of Product Operations | Acme Industries
maria.jenkins@acme.com

Thanks Maria - great context and helpful priorities. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

On BYOK / keys:
- We support customer-managed keys for both Dedicated and Private VPC. For Dedicated this is via KMS integration (we can register your AWS KMS keys for the Dedicated pool). Private VPC gives you full control over key rotation and HSM if required. I'll have Marissa include the exact KMS steps in the updated plan.

SRE requirements for Dedicated:
- Allowlist Redwood egress IPs (we'll provide a short list).
- Token-based auth for API calls; we'll provide deployable client snippets.
- No SSH to our runtime; access is via authenticated APIs and optional private peering for Private VPC.

Proposed next actions:
1) Schedule 30-minute alignment call next week to finalize scope + confirm access. Suggested slots: Thu Mar 4 10:00am PT, Thu Mar 4 3:00pm PT, or Tue Mar 9 11:00am PT.
2) We'll attach an updated PoC plan with two-track details (Dedicated baseline + Private VPC validation) and a short checklist for SRE/security. (Attached: PoC_trial_plan_two-track_v2.pdf)
3) Once you confirm the slot and stakeholder list, we'll provision a Dedicated trial pool and share onboarding steps.

I've quoted your notes below for the team. If any of the stakeholders need to be looped in directly to the kickoff invite, please let me know.
